description: This file contains a function 'insertInvoiceQuery' that performs multiple database insert operations to create a new invoice record along with related entities such as invoice fields, company details, client details, invoice details, billing details, items, metadata, and payment information. It uses external libraries for UUID generation, decimal handling, and database interaction, and references various schema definitions and constants.

methods.name: insertInvoiceQuery
methods.description: Asynchronously inserts a new invoice and related data into the database, handling multiple related insert operations and error checking, and returns the invoice ID.
